concept: Grille is the perforated field of a dial unit whose recessed holes are the meter itself. Lit holes in printing ink show a level, activity or signal, and the value is always named for assistive tech.

default_to_avoid.pattern: decorative grille: a CSS radial-gradient dot-pattern background behind content
default_to_avoid.why_not: A printed dot pattern carries no reading, and P4 says holes exist only where they carry a value and are recesses, never printed dots.

default_to_avoid.pattern: coloured equaliser bar graph used as a grille or level meter
default_to_avoid.why_not: Coloured bars spend hue on a reading, while P4 lights holes in ink at full step and P1 keeps orange for the one control.

references.source: Braun T 1000 world receiver (Dieter Rams, 1963): a perforated speaker field on a flat aluminium face
Braun L 2 loudspeaker: a square field of round holes on the module grid of the case
apps/lab/anchor/index.html: card A's 12-column grille that lights columns as the volume level (D-001)

derivation.consequence: grille pitch is one module step, so holes sit on the same grid as the body's inset
derivation.form: Each hole is space-2 across with a space-1 gap, a 12px pitch on the 4px step.

derivation.consequence: holes are circles; their field is a rectangle or circle that nests in the body
derivation.form: Holes have corner.round; shape circle leaves holes outside the inscribed circle undrawn, while their grid cells keep the field square.

derivation.consequence: each hole is a recess (inverse light), never a printed dot
derivation.form: Every hole carries elevation.well so its shade falls on the top-left inner edge, like the display window.

derivation.consequence: holes are ink at a lower step; a lit level uses ink at full step, never orange
derivation.form: An unlit hole is grille.hole and a lit hole grille.hole-on; the accent is never used in a grille.

derivation.consequence: a level change fills holes in reading order, ≤120ms, none under Reduce motion
derivation.form: Holes light in fill order, start of line first or bottom row first, and their colour fades over motion.fill.

derivation.consequence: links, borders, icons, selections and charts never use it
derivation.form: A grille is a chart of one reading, so neither unlit nor lit holes ever take action.accent.

derivation.consequence: no entry choreography, no idle animation; transitions only on state
derivation.form: Holes never pulse or sweep at rest; they change only when the value prop changes.

derivation.consequence: a grille that shows a value exposes it as text to assistive tech; a decorative grille is not allowed to exist
derivation.form: The root is role meter with a required label, aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and an aria-valuetext sentence.

options.name: rectangle field, columns fill along the line
circle field, rows fill bottom to top
sparse strip, one large hole per step

variants.reason: A is the anchor card's own grille, a rectangle on the module pitch that reads as a level from the start of the line (P4 space, motion); B's circle field and bottom-up fill stay available as shape and fill options, and C's large holes break the one-step pitch P4 sets.

root.why: The field is a grid of holes on one module pitch, so it sits on the same grid as the body's inset.

hole.why: Each hole is a round recess with inverse light, shaded on its top-left inner edge, never a printed dot.

on.why: A lit hole is ink at full step so the level reads at 3:1 or more against unlit holes, never orange.

void.why: Cells outside the inscribed circle stay empty so a circle field nests in its square without moving holes.

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: Under reduce motion holes switch to their new level at once, with no fade between readings.

@media forced-colors: active.why: In forced colours each hole keeps a border and lit holes take the system text colour, so the level stays readable.

background-color.why: A hole lights and dims over motion.segment, the same step as the window's figures, so a level that moves reads as the grille breathing, never as holes blinking (D-008).
